Orion StarBlast 4.5 Astro Reflector

The grab-and-go tabletop that hooks kids and adults alike.

around $250

A 114mm wide-field reflector on a tiny Dobsonian base — put it on a table and you're observing in 60 seconds. The perfect 'is this hobby for me?' telescope: cheap, fun, and genuinely capable on the Moon, planets and bright deep-sky.

  • Sets up in a minute, anywhere

  • Small aperture limits faint objects
